instruction.name: xvldi
instruction.description: Load a 256-bit vector register with a sign-extended immediate.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvldi $xr0, 1; xvldi $xr1, 1; xvldi $xr2, 1; xvldi $xr3, 1; xvldi $xr4, 1; xvldi $xr5, 1; xvldi $xr6, 1; xvldi $xr7, 1
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x0102030405060708; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr1, $r4; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr2, $r4' --asm 'xvldi $xr0, 1; xvldi $xr1, 1; xvldi $xr2, 1; xvldi $xr3, 1; xvldi $xr4, 1; xvldi $xr5, 1; xvldi $xr6, 1; xvldi $xr7, 1'

notes: No source operand data dependency; latency is not defined. Throughput only. Re-derived with the two-cycle cross-domain calibration: movfr2gr and movgr2fr are 2 cycles each, movgr2frh.w is 3, the flag pair is 7/15, vpickve2gr is 3, xvpickve2gr is 5, and vreplgr2vr/xvreplgr2vr are 2 (3 for the byte and half-word broadcast).
